name: commissioning a record
from: A roster of offices, duties, and skills whose records may or may not still say what they claim, checked only by a careful reader choosing to be careful.
to: A roster equal to the work actually answered for: a record commissioned when there is work nobody answers for, retired when it answers for nothing, and every seated record proved by machine — never by reading — to conform to its schema and resolve every reference.
cost: The commissioning act's attention — the drafting, the filing, and the machine check — paid at every change to the roster rather than once.
otherwise: The record drifts silently, and emsenn is the only instrument that detects it: a careful reader is exactly what is unavailable at 2am in a rushed session. Office, duty, and skill are one commissioning contract read three ways, which is why this is one work and not three.
